about: Portugal Cove–St. Philip’s is a town on Newfoundland’s northeast Avalon, facing Conception Bay just northwest of St. John’s—not the capital itself. A former fishing harbour now largely suburban, it is the ferry point for Bell Island and a trailhead for rugged coastal paths. About 8,000 people live in Portugal Cove–St. Philip’s.
seoSummary: Conception Bay town northwest of St. John’s—Bell Island ferry, fishing-harbour heritage, and coastal trails, not the capital.
